title: Winning lotto bettor gets P12 million prize after 12 years
summary: A man who won the lottery 12 years ago was finally able to get his P12 million prize.

blocks.text: A man who won the lottery 12 years ago was finally able to get his P12 million prize.

According to a report from Vonne Aquino on What We Know So Far, a bettor was able to get the winning combination for the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office's (PCSO) 6/42 Lotto draw on October 2, 2014
However, the PCSO denied his claim to the prize after his child accidentally ironed the winning ticket, causing part of it to become blackened.
The PCSO argued that the ticket should be readable.
The bettor questioned the decision before the court, and the case reached all the way to the Supreme Court (SC). The SC eventually ruled in favor of the bettor.
The SC ordered the PCSO to give the bettor the prize back in 2023, but due to several processes, the office was only able to give him the money on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
PCSO General Manager Melquides Robles personally handed over the check to the winning bettor.
In addition to the P12,391,600 prize, the amount accrued 6% annual legal interest, bringing the total to P14,157,281.
The bettor said that the money is a big help to his family, as they have a lot of debts. He also plans to start his own business with the cash. —Jean Mangaluz/LDF, GMA News
